description: 擅长战斗的军团士兵。一个皮革包、一个小包，生命 {max_hp}、耐力 {max_stamina}、耐力回得最快：打得狠、打得久、打赢了得的多。

descriptions.en: A legion soldier who is good at fighting. One leather bag and one small bag, Health {max_hp}, Stamina {max_stamina} and the fastest Stamina regeneration: hits hard, lasts long and earns more from wins.

skills.description: 战斗胜利所得金币增加四分之一。

descriptions.en: Coins from winning battles are increased by a quarter.

skills.description: 耐力低于两成时，立即恢复 {change_resource_amount} 点耐力（每场一次）。

descriptions.en: When your Stamina drops below a fifth, restore {change_resource_amount} Stamina at once (once per battle).

skills.description: 下次战斗开始时，先扣除敌方三成生命。

descriptions.en: At the start of your next battle, the enemy first loses three tenths of its Health.

flaw.description: 战斗中，【药剂】给的治疗减半。

descriptions.en: In battle, healing from Remedies is halved.
